scientific_integrity: The infinite-class theorem follows from an analytic renewal-kernel inequality; finite floating-point tests only corroborate algebra. Independent scientific audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The Brownian starting position is independently redrawn from the reset law at time zero and on every Poisson reset.
The reset-to-target distance law must have a bounded nonincreasing density with positive finite value at zero. This is sufficient, not necessary.
No claims cover quenched restart sites, nonzero return costs, drift, interactions, or all distance laws.
Exact mathematical monotonicity is established, but scientific publication priority is not independently certified.
title: Strictly decreasing first-passage noise under decreasing-distance resetting
